arg.name: live_sensor
arg.description: If true, sensor drivers will be executed (for actual recording operation)

arg.name: publish_pointcloud
arg.description: If false, pointcloud decoding will not be performed (for actual recording operation)

arg.name: has_front4d
arg.description: Should be True when a front-mounted 4D LiDAR is present

arg.name: publish_tf
arg.description: Should be False when LiDAR-camera extrinsic calibration

arg.name: lidar_driver_type
arg.description: Type of LiDAR driver to use: nebula or seyond

arg.name: has_vehicle_can
arg.description: Should be True when vehicle CAN is available

arg.name: has_fisheye
arg.description: Should be True when a fisheye camera is present
